ceu: ✦ The trine between Mercury and Uranus

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.
